portability.scope: Removed author metadata, replaced unused host interpreter default, omitted runtime-overridden host paths, and parameterized standalone wrapper locations.

scope: Adaptive 2-50 controller snapshot with deployment-sanitized launcher/configs. Algorithm, control state machine, task parameters and budgets are unchanged; provider, model, proxy handling and host GPU defaults are deployment configuration.
derivation: Pinned local 2-50 policy delta plus explicit deployment sanitization; not a byte-identical upstream export

deployment_sanitization.scope: Removed private service/model defaults and personal source-path labels; required ROBORSI_CODEX_BASE_URL and ROBORSI_CODEX_MODEL, runtime provider, CODEX_API_KEY, caller-selected proxy environment, and portable physical GPU default. Parent file hashes retain source traceability.
deployment_sanitization.identity_contract: Legacy factory requires the environment model to match its prepared identity; launch rejects subsequent model drift.
